tool_input.command:
mkdir -p .tmp submission
awk 'NR==1{print "id,ts,prediction"; next}{print (NR-1)","$0}' data/prediction_log.csv > .tmp/pred_log.csv
wc -l .tmp/pred_log.csv; head -3 .tmp/pred_log.csv; tail -1 .tmp/pred_log.csv

hops fg create prediction_log --version 1 \
  --primary-key id \
  --features "id:bigint:row id,ts:string:iso utc timestamp,prediction:double:model output" \
  --description "Deployed model logged predictions for monitoring" \
  --json 2>&1 | tail -30
hops fg insert prediction_log --version 1 --file .tmp/pred_log.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -25

hops sql "SELECT substr(ts,1,10) AS day, count(*) n, round(avg(prediction),4) mean, round(stddev(prediction),4) sd, round(min(prediction),3) mn, round(max(prediction),3) mx FROM prediction_log_1 GROUP BY substr(ts,1,10) ORDER BY day" --json 2>&1 | tail -40
